about: A place's receipts are read at a resolution: at N a receipt stands in the region the first N steps of its scope spell, as the line spells them, so every resolution is a partition; @0 is the root, @1 the family. A region's digest is over each line's claim (scope, role, measure, form, value, at; never by, epoch or sig), canonical, sorted by bytes, each followed by a newline; the regions go in the byte order of their names and the root is the digest of their digests, each followed by a newline, in that order; a line the attest key signed is never one of them. The readings are receipts/<family> (count, digest) and receipts (the root), returned by fold/resolved.ts resolved(fold) with the digest of the @8 bytes as at; no receipt's value moves and no digest is copied into a line.
